name: neurons-brain
description: Neurons: the user's personal knowledge brain as a Desk mod. Offers to search prior knowledge before researching and to capture a decision or a learning, through the Neurons MCP server.

offers.title: Check the brain first
offers.summary: Search the knowledge brain for what is already known about this topic before researching it from scratch, and cite what it finds as n:<slug>.
offers.restraint: Not for small talk, a question about this repo's own code, or a topic already searched in this conversation.

offers.title: Note what we just learned
offers.summary: Save something observed first-hand in this session (a measurement, an experiment, behaviour verified by running it) as a source note neurons can cite.
offers.restraint: Only for something verified in this session; not for a guess, a restatement of docs, or anything that holds a secret.

offers.title: Save this decision to the brain
offers.summary: Write the decision just made, with its reasons and the evidence it rests on, as neurons that cite a source, so later sessions in any repo find it.
offers.restraint: Only after a real decision with a reason; never for a tentative idea, a routine edit or a choice the repo already records.
